name: Stratum Drift
description: Long-form parallax page of rotated image grids, drifting columns and large italic breakout words between text paragraphs, with smooth scrolling and a preloader.
contents: Large title, two paragraphs, two breakout phrases and a back-to-top button
Three image grids: rotated rows, straight rows and vertical columns
Full-screen loader dot shown while images preload
behavior: Elements drift along x or y based on scroll position with eased smoothing
Back button scrolls smoothly to the top section
Parallax is disabled when reduced motion is preferred

props.name: paragraphOne
props.default: The human world is exploding at the seams. Human creativity and the implementation of human inventions and technology is now at an accelerated fever pitch like nothing ever before seen in the history of the world. Well, where is it leading, and how does one integrate this stuff into one's own life? What does it mean about the experience of being human? I have proposed the existence of an invisible, permeating Something that is throughout all being, all time, all space, all bodies, all thought, which I call Novelty; and the interesting thing about novelty is that it is increasing constantly.

props.name: paragraphTwo
props.default: The conservation of novelty is simply that, over time, the universe has become more complicated. New levels of complexity become the foundations for yet deeper levels of complexity. And this phenomenon of the production and conservation of what I call novelty is not something which goes on only in the biological domain or only in the cultural domain or only in the domain of physics. It is a trans-categorical impulse in reality, meaning: it is everywhere.

props.name: breakoutMedium
props.default: the greatest barrier to your enlightenment
